knownIssues.text: A failing intermediate-shaft bearing can cause major engine damage. Applicable bearing design and accessibility depend on the engine and production history.

prevention.text: Ask a Porsche specialist to identify the installed engine and bearing design, then review any documented prior bearing work.

driving.text: Accurate steering and flat-six response make this a chassis benchmark. Grip can require a brisk pace to reveal the full range.

styling.text: The fastback and deep side inlets give it its own identity while the nose remains clearly related to the Boxster.
